lines.say: Yesterday you picked a door. Here is what was behind each one.
Door A. Your mom is cooking. Your favourite dinner. She smiles a little too wide.
Then you notice. She has no shadow. Nobody in Door A has a shadow.
Door B. Cold and quiet, because you left the window open this morning. It is just your flat.
Your phone buzzes. Your mom. Did you get home safe? She is in another city.
Did you pick the right door? Write it in the comments.
